name: Stage Performance Attribution Coupling 01
bounded_question: What spatial attribution grammar best strengthens the relationship between the Stage's dominant Character-attributed Performance region and its source/performing Character without turning Performance into a chat bubble, permanent transcript rail, observation/knowledge signal, durable-consequence claim or creator control?
single_variable: static spatial attribution coupling between one dominant Performance region and its human-readable source Character
authority_limits: PERF-S1 does not decide whether a displayed Performance is current, accepted, recent, pending or canon; runtime state semantics remain outside this gate.
Performance occurrence must not be styled as Observation, Knowledge, Memory, Belief, Suspicion, agreement or durable consequence.
The Stage hierarchy remains one dominant Performance region plus secondary recent history; history density, retention depth and Archive geometry are not candidates.
The incumbent RECENT BEATS wording is held only as content-control evidence and does not resolve ODR-14 or establish final terminology.
Human-readable source Character identity remains explicit in every specimen; no family may depend on color, portrait recognition, motion or spatial memory alone.
Cones, floor/name hinges, pips, right rail, creator actions, palette, typography tokens and implementation remain outside this gate.
No outcome creates production layout tokens or Stage authority without a later separately frozen exact-incumbent comparison.

incumbent_content_control.dominant_copy: These fibers match the raft’s mooring line. And look at the prints — someone moved our supplies at low tide. This wasn’t the storm. Someone here knows more than they’re saying.

secondary_history_rows.text: The fibers are fresh. Not from the storm. Someone cut this.
Low tide would have given them cover. The prints head toward the north cove.
Coincidence is a comforting story, but the island rarely offers them.
We can argue later. Right now we need to ration food. The stores won’t last.

incumbent_content_control.matrix_use: The exact Marlowe block is rendered once per family in the five-Character incumbent-content comparison. Source-position stress specimens use neutral text bars so changing source identity cannot invent fictional dialogue or confound geometry with copy length.

neutral_stage_scaffold.character_carrier: neutral abstract presence locus plus human-readable name; not a new cone design and not production geometry

CINC.name: Detached Incumbent Panel Control
CINC.geometry: full-width fixed Performance panel below the Character field; source name remains at the panel's leading edge
CINC.purpose: Calibrates the current detached relationship without claiming that the raster geometry is a production layout token.

CNEG.name: Centered Detached Attribution Negative Control
CNEG.geometry: same fixed panel and content hierarchy, but source attribution is centered independently of source Character position
CNEG.expected_failure: Human-readable source remains present, but the spatial relationship deliberately carries no source-position information.

F1.name: Source-Aligned Dock
F1.mechanism: Move the dominant Performance region as a bounded dock toward the source Character while preserving the fixed internal content-column width and secondary-history count/order.
F1.risk: May privatize a shared Stage occurrence into a personal card/chat bubble or distort Stage balance for edge Characters.

F2.name: Source-Aligned Header
F2.mechanism: Keep the global panel fixed while aligning only its source-attribution header with the source Character's horizontal locus; dominant text and recent-history geometry stay fixed.
F2.risk: May be too subtle to strengthen attribution, or may read as a selected column/tab rather than authorship.

F3.name: Floor Witness Line
F3.mechanism: Keep the incumbent panel fixed and add one neutral one-pixel vertical witness from the source Character floor/name locus to the panel top edge; no arrowhead, dot, tail, animation or color coding.
F3.risk: May read as speech-tail, causal arrow, selection tether, turn queue, Opportunity indicator or relationship edge.

F4.name: Source Edge Aperture
F4.mechanism: Keep the incumbent panel fixed but interrupt its top border with a small source-aligned aperture; place the source name immediately inside that aligned opening without any line reaching the Character.
F4.risk: May read as a speech bubble notch, notification-card tab, selected segment or decorative pointer.

family_separation_law: F1 tests whole-region proximity/alignment while keeping internal text-column width fixed.
F2 tests attribution-header alignment while leaving the region itself global and fixed.
F3 tests an explicit minimal connector while leaving panel and header geometry otherwise incumbent-like.
F4 tests a source-aligned panel-edge interruption without any connector reaching the Character.
No family may change Performance copy semantics, secondary-history count/order, Character identities, cone/state treatment, palette, typeface role, motion or creator actions.
CINC and CNEG are calibration controls and cannot win.

matrix.stress_copy: Neutral performance text block — semantic content intentionally withheld for attribution-geometry stress.
matrix.incumbent_content_layout: five Characters with Marlowe as source using exact incumbent dominant copy and fixed four-row recent-history control
matrix.forced_colors_law: All Character names, source identity, dominant Performance text/control label and recent-history structure remain understandable if decorative borders, witness lines or apertures are suppressed or system-colored.
matrix.narrow_law: At 320px, the same source/Performance relationship must remain understandable without horizontal document overflow, permanent side rail, hidden source identity or reliance on simultaneous wide-column scanning.

mechanical_falsifiers: Any family removes the human-readable source Character name from either the Character field or dominant Performance attribution.
Any family changes the dominant Performance semantic text, secondary-history count/order, or introduces new fictional content after freeze.
Any family depends on non-neutral color, animation, transition, portrait recognition or state-specific cone treatment.
Any source-coupling marker is attached to a non-source Character or misses its intended source locus beyond the frozen tolerance.
F1 changes the fixed internal content-column width or causes the dominant region to collide with Character names/floor loci.
F2 source header fails to track the source locus within 12 CSS px in wide specimens.
F3 witness is wider than one CSS px, gains arrowheads/dots, or extends into the Character carrier rather than terminating below the floor/name locus.
F4 aperture is wider than 44 CSS px or is not centered within 12 CSS px of the source locus.
Any forced-colors specimen loses explicit source identity or dominant Performance text/control meaning.
Any 320px specimen causes horizontal document overflow.
subjective_falsifiers: The dominant Performance reads primarily as a chat bubble, direct message, speech balloon or private Character card rather than a shared Stage occurrence.
The spatial cue implies Observation, Knowledge, Memory, agreement, durable consequence, creator selection, Current Opportunity or causal direction.
The source relationship remains ambiguous for a noncentral or edge source Character despite explicit text.
The coupling ornament competes with the Character carriers or makes the Performance region visually more important than the live Stage.
Secondary recent history becomes a permanent transcript rail or appears to share the same source relationship as the dominant Performance.
The dominant region reads as a toast, notification card, selected tab, inspector or creator control.
The 320px transfer loses the same source-attribution relationship or requires hidden/hover-only context.
The mechanism needs exact color, motion, portrait recognition or wide-layout position to remain understandable.
evaluation_priority: source Character attribution becomes immediately clearer than the detached incumbent control
Performance still reads as a shared Stage occurrence rather than private speech/chat
one dominant Performance plus secondary recent history hierarchy remains intact
Character/cone presence remains visually primary over the Performance coupling ornament
the mechanism avoids epistemic, consequence, selection, Opportunity and causal-arrow implications
edge-source and noncentral-source layouts remain coherent
320px and forced-colors transfer preserve attribution without hidden context
the mechanism adds the least structural ornament needed to improve attribution

promotion_law.multiple_survivors: Apply evaluation_priority in order. If two candidates remain materially tied, close without a selected survivor rather than create a result-aware hybrid.
promotion_law.promotion_scope: Any survivor is provisional neutral attribution-coupling evidence only and must later survive a separately frozen exact-incumbent Stage comparison before gaining Stage authority.

source_freeze.freeze_law: Complete source-only verification, then replace only the pending harness hash before first visual/browser exposure. No family geometry, content, falsifier or decision law may change after exposure.

required_diagnostics: two controls and four candidate families materialize
2/3/4/5 Character source-position stress specimens materialize for every family
one exact incumbent-content five-Character specimen materializes for every family
source Character and source attribution remain human-readable
candidate-specific geometry matches the frozen method
dominant Performance plus secondary recent-history hierarchy remains intact
forced-colors fallback retains source and content semantics
no horizontal overflow at either viewport

recursive_preflight_requirements: Patch 0015 occurrence-versus-epistemic and occurrence-versus-consequence distinctions remain intact
Stage current/recent hierarchy remains intact without selecting transcript geometry
ODR-14 and Beat terminology remain unresolved
full chronology remains progressive/on-demand rather than permanent Stage furniture
single-variable spatial attribution isolation is exact
closed CIR-S1/CONE-S1/STATE-S1 results are not reopened
no motion, palette, creator-action, right-rail or implementation authority is created
no renderer or full Stage image is used before neutral method evaluation closes
next_action: Materialize the deterministic neutral PERF-S1 harness, verifier and browser probe from this frozen contract; perform source-only audit and hash freeze before any visual exposure.
